prompt: Create an original 90 second Middle Eastern acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for science explainer, tutorial and educational narration. Mood: curious, clear, thoughtful. Instruments: oud, qanun, darbuka. Style: ornamented modal melody with rolling hand-drum rhythm. Tempo approximately 98 BPM; G major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Keep the lead sparse and the midrange uncluttered for spoken narration. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A melodic and gentle acoustic piece featuring intricate classical guitar work, possibly with a mandolin or similar plucked string instrument, creating a calm and reflective atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首旋律优美、柔和的纯器乐作品，以精湛的古典吉他演奏为主，可能还伴有曼陀林或类似的拨弦乐器，营造出平静而沉思的氛围。
